articles.summary: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd (Credo) (Nasdaq: CRDO), an innovator in providing connectivity at scale through fast, reliable, and energy-efficient system solutions, today announced financial results for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, ended August 1, 2026.
